Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust.

 

In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information.

 

  • Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment
  • Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories
  • Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance
  • Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness
  • Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models

 

Qualifications to succeed in this project:

 

  • Professional fluency in English
  • Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years  
  • Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture
  • Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities
  • Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher)
  • Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven professionals with strong research methodology (preferred)

 

Why join the project:

 

  • Fully remote flexibility: Structure your contributions around research, consulting, teaching, or other professional commitments without rigid scheduling
  • Comprehensive research support: Access detailed evaluation guidelines, reference materials, databases, and resources for fact-checking across domains
  • Quality recognition: Performance assessments focused on consistency, fact-checking precision, and nuanced judgment
  • Intellectually demanding by design: If you are driven by fact-checking precision, source authority analysis, and the challenge of identifying what makes information truly trustworthy, this work is built for that mindset.
  • Responsive support: Direct access to evaluation support staff for clarification on ambiguous queries or technical guidance
  Qualification path

How to get started:

  • Complete your contributor profile and application

  • Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process
  • Acceptance form & Rater Academy: Complete an acceptance form and approximately 2.5 hours of Rater Academy training

Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

  • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Back-End

Front-End

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration

  • Impactful Work: Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights.

Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them.

We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone.

We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world.


What you'll do
  • Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way.
  • Write video scripts and outlines.
  • Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos.

What we're looking for
  • Native-level written and spoken English
  • Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently

  • Reliable, organized, and able to work independently and take ownership of your projects

  • A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise
  • Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload
  • Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada


Nice to have
  • Previous experience creating educational video content
  • Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other areas we regularly create videos about
  • Equipment needed to produce high-quality videos


Working at Metics Media

At Metics Media, you'll have a lot of freedom in how you work. You'll be trusted to structure your own day, manage your projects independently, and take ownership of your work. Role Overview:

  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

What we’re looking for

  • Strong proficiency in React, Next.js, TypeScript/JavaScript.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS for production workloads.

  • Solid understanding of web security best practices (OWASP, secure storage, encryption in transit/at rest, secrets management).

  • Experience building systems in or adjacent to healthcare, education, or compliance-heavy environments is a plus.

  • Excellent async communication, code ownership, and ability to work with a small, senior-led team.

  • Comfort working from a clear product brief and also proposing improvements proactively.

  • Familiarity with logging, monitoring, and observability tools.

Take-home assignment (Step 1 of the process)

Please complete a take-home assignment. You are allowed to use LLMs to write code. To ensure that your work will not be used at Fluence, we’ve made it unrelated to healthcare:

Build “LendLoop”: a neighborhood tool-lending board with automated workflows

A simple app where neighbors list tools they are willing to lend, request to borrow from each other, and receive automated notifications and reminders handled by n8n.

Stack

  • Next.js (App Router)

  • Clerk for authentication

  • Convex for data + backend logic

  • n8n (self-hosted via Docker or n8n Cloud) for workflow automation

  • TypeScript

Requirements

Public page

  • The fictional company name is LendLoop.

  • Short tagline, e.g. “Borrow what you need. Lend what you don’t.”

  • Show:

  • A “Sign in to lend or borrow” button wired to Clerk.

Authenticated experience

  • Only signed-in users can:

  • List a tool with:

  • name

  • category (power tools, garden, kitchen, camping, etc.)

  • condition

  • short description

  • Request to borrow a tool for a date range.

  • Approve or decline requests on their own tools.

  • Mark a loan as returned.

  • Show:

  • All tools with availability status, filterable by category.

  • “My listings”, “My requests”, and “Incoming requests” views.

  • Nice, minimal layout.

Roles & rules

  • admin:

  • user:

    • Can create, edit, and delete only their own listings, and act only on requests involving their own tools or their own borrowing.

  • Implement the above role-based access control with best practices, enforced in Convex functions, not only in the UI.

WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

At Proxima Fusion, we are building the future of clean energy - and we need an experienced Warehouse Specialist who thrives in a fast-paced, hands-on environment. In this role, you will ensure the smooth and efficient flow of materials and equipment, supporting our engineering, R&D, and operational ambitions. You’ll be responsible for managing incoming and outgoing goods, maintaining accurate inventory records, coordinating shipments, and ensuring the safe handling and storage of materials. With a strong focus on reliability, precision, and continuous improvement, you’ll play a key role in building efficient and scalable warehouse operations that support our mission to make fusion energy a reality.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Goods receipt and inspection: Receive deliveries from suppliers, carriers and couriers. Check each one against the purchase order and delivery note for quantity, part number and condition. Look for transport damage, moisture, contamination or tampering. Verify labels, batch and serial numbers, and shelf life.

  • Non-conformance and claims: Photograph and document any findings. Move non-conforming goods to blocked or quarantine stock and raise non-conformance reports. File claims with carriers, inform Purchasing, and hand parts that need detailed inspection to Quality. Release or return them based on Quality’s decision.

  • System accuracy (ERP/WMS): Post goods receipts and goods issues accurately and on time, including labels, barcodes, and batch and serial numbers. Book goods in only after they pass the receipt checks. Keep physical stock and system stock in sync.

  • Dispatch and shipping documents: Pick, pack and prepare shipments according to packing instructions. Create delivery notes, labels, CMR consignment notes and packing lists. For non-EU shipments, prepare proforma invoices and export documents with the logistics team. Prepare ADR transport documents for hazardous goods.

  • Carrier coordination and returns: Book and coordinate pickups, and track shipments until they’re delivered. Handle returns and re-shipments to suppliers through the RMA process.

  • Loading, unloading and transport: Load and unload trucks and vans safely with forklifts and pallet jacks, and secure loads correctly. Handle heavy, bulky, sensitive or high-value components with care. Run scheduled milk runs between company sites and local suppliers using company vehicles.

  • Storage, replenishment and inventory: Sort, label and store goods in the correct locations. Replenish production and line-side stock (Kanban or min/max) in time for manufacturing. Take part in the annual stocktake and resolve stock differences. Manage packaging materials: stock levels, reordering, reuse and recycling.

  • Housekeeping and safety: Keep receiving, storage and dispatch areas clean and organised with a 5S mindset. Separate and dispose of waste according to German recycling rules. Follow health and safety rules and wear PPE. Report hazards, near-misses and accidents, and carry out daily checks on forklifts and handling equipment.

  • Cross-functional coordination: Work with Purchasing, Production, Quality, Engineering and Finance on material availability, priorities and urgent shipments, and keep internal customers informed.

  • Continuous improvement and travel: Suggest and support improvements to warehouse processes, layout and digital tools. Travel within the EU when needed, for example to suppliers, partner sites or with special shipments.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Completed vocational training as Fachkraft für Lagerlogistik, Fachlagerist/in or a comparable qualification, or equivalent hands-on experience.

  • At least 5 years of experience in goods receipt, dispatch or warehousing, ideally in a manufacturing environment.

  • Valid EU/German driving licence, class B.

  • Valid forklift licence (Staplerschein per DGUV Grundsatz 308-001) and confident operation of counterbalance forklifts.

  • Fluent German and English, spoken and written (at least B2 in both).

  • Tech-savvy: confident with ERP/WMS systems (e.g. SAP or similar), barcode scanners, Google Workspace, and email.

  • Good knowledge of shipping documents and processes (delivery notes, CMR, Incoterms basics).

  • Knowledge of load securing and safe handling of goods.

  • Willingness to travel within the EU when required.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

Location: 100% remote (EMEA + South America)

Miaplaza is looking for two Engineering Managers to lead two of our software development teams. We’re hiring for one existing team of 7 engineers and one new team that we will hire developers into.

This is a management role for someone who wants to grow as a manager while still remaining hands-on with code. You'll split your time roughly 50/50 between leading your team and doing hands-on work alongside them.

About Miaplaza

Miaplaza is dedicated to making education engaging and accessible through innovative online learning platforms. We develop personalized learning experiences for students, helping them grow in a supportive and interactive environment. Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive education curriculum platform where all students can be successful!

As an engineering manager at Miaplaza, your team will build technology with a direct impact on the lives of hundreds of thousands of students. Every step of the way, you will have the opportunity to influence our direction. Through our platforms, we create engaging, safe, and thoughtfully designed learning experiences that help children grow academically, creatively, and personally. Every feature we ship, every system we scale, and every improvement we make contributes to shaping how the next generation learns and discovers their potential. If our platform is down, a child might not go to school that day. We’re looking for leaders who want their work to matter in classrooms and homes, who care about access to quality education, and who are excited to craft technology that makes a difference in young people’s lives. Here, your impact doesn’t just power a product; it shapes future generations!

What you’ll work on

We’re a C# and Vue.js platform growing towards a scale that no longer matches our legacy architecture. You’ll need to work with your team balancing both product and engineering initiatives. You’ll report to our head of engineering and be expected to split your time roughly 50/50 between people management and hands-on development. Prioritization always goes to leading and supporting your engineers.

How management works at Miaplaza

We're a US-based company, so this may differ from what you've done before:

  1. You start as an engineer. You’ll onboard as a senior engineer on your own team for two months, begin manager onboarding in month two, and take over the team at around week 10. Both phases matter equally, and this isn’t negotiable.

  2. You stay hands-on. Around 50% of your time stays hands-on after onboarding, but leading and supporting your engineers always comes first.

  3. You teach. Growing your engineers and those around you is a core responsibility. You'll have full oversight of your direct reports' work, because you can't teach well without seeing the process behind the output.

  4. Feedback is the norm. You'll give specific reinforcement and constructive feedback whenever you notice something, and you'll receive it too.


What you must bring

We can only move forward with candidates who meet these requirements:

  • 7+ years of experience in software development in one or more object-oriented programming languages

  • 3+ years of experience with front-end software development in a reactive front-end framework

  • 3+ years of experience with software architecture

  • 3+ years of experience operating at a Senior, Staff, or Principal Engineer level

  • 2+ years of experience being a mentor/leader

  • 1+ years leading a team, formally or as a tech lead

  • Experience working directly with product and design on scoping and prioritization

  • Experience being on-call and resolving production incidents

  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

What makes you stand out

  • Experience leading a team through a significant architectural migration

  • Experience with consumer platforms at scale

  • Experience building in regulated environments

  • Experience with DevOps technologies (eg K8s, IaC, sysadmin, build pipelines, etc.)

  • Extensive senior front-end development experience

Responsibilities

  • Work with your teams to design, develop, and maintain scalable and reliable web applications using primarily C# and Vue.js

  • Collaborate with your product trio (PM, UX, EM), product leadership team, and other EMs to scope, prioritize, and deliver features that matter to students and families

  • Set the quality bar for your team. You'll have dedicated capacity for reliability and architecture work rather than fitting it around feature delivery, and a strong say in where that capacity goes.

  • Manage, lead, and mentor your team while working side by side with them in code quality, clean architecture, soft skills, best practices, etc

  • Lead team trainings, set SMART goals, hold performance reviews, and provide individual feedback recurrently to each of your devs

Our hiring process

As a remote company, we receive a large number of applicants, so our process is longer than usual. At every stage we try to respect your time.

  1. Application and CV review. We review your application answers and CV, then follow up with an update.

  2. Initial technical screen (20 min). A few administrative questions and short technical questions related to the role.

  3. Behavioral interview (1 hour). With a member of our HR team, about your experience and approach so far.

  4. 1st technical interview (1 hour). With a member of the engineering team to answer technical questions tailored to our work.

  5. 2nd technical interview (1 hour). With a member of the engineering team to dive into a hypothetical scenario and how you’d tackle it.

  6. Leadership interview (1 hour). With our Head of Engineering or executive leadership.

  7. Reference check. We contact the 3 references you provide, including at least one former or current manager, a colleague, and a former or current direct report.

  8. Offer and background check. Once you sign your offer, we run a background check in accordance with applicable law.

We give honest, timely feedback at every step. Job searches are hard; we don't want to make yours harder.

Compensation

The pay range for this role is €82,000 - 140,000. Our compensation philosophy aims for equity and competitiveness while considering regional differences in labor costs. Placement in the range depends on demonstrated skills, internal equity and local labor market rates for your area.

Analytics first: Du baust CRM und Lifecycle Marketing bei Foodji komplett neu auf, vom analytischen Fundament bis zur Integration der Systeme – datengetrieben, KI-enabled und mit hohem Iterationstempo.

In dieser neu geschaffenen Rolle verantwortest du die Segmentierungs- und Journey-Logik unserer B2C-Kommunikation. Dein Werkzeug sind Daten, nicht Pixel: Du entwickelst Hypothesen, übersetzt sie in Events, Segmente und Journey-Konzepte, wertest Tests aus und iterierst schnell auf Basis der Ergebnisse. Kampagnen und Content kommen aus dem Marketing- und UI/UX-Team, du lieferst das Wer, Wann und Warum. Rund 60 bis 70 Prozent deiner Arbeit sind Analytics, und KI-Tools wie Claude nutzt du dabei ganz selbstverständlich.

Foodji ist dabei kein klassischer Onlineshop: Jeder Foodji hat individuelle Stocklevels und Produktkombinationen. Genau das macht CRM bei uns besonders spannend. Dazu kommt eine riesige Datenbasis: Fast alle Kund:innen sind registriert und haben ein eigenes Profil. Du entwickelst die Logik für dynamische, hochgradig segmentierte Kommunikation über alle Kanäle – von der Foodji App über In-App-Messages, Push und Mail bis zum Foodji Screen direkt am Gerät – und nutzt Daten, um sie kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Deine Mission bei Foodji

  • Du legst das analytische und konzeptionelle Fundament für eine skalierbare CRM- und Lifecycle-Funktion für unsere B2C-Kund:innen.

  • Von der Hypothese über Segmentierung und Testdesign bis zur Auswertung von A/B-Tests und Kohorten: Du definierst, was wir ausprobieren, misst, was wirkt, und iterierst schnell auf Basis der Ergebnisse.

  • Welche Events lösen welche Kommunikation aus? Du definierst sie auf Basis unserer Daten, konzipierst dynamische Segmente und Journeys, die Stocklevels, Produktkombinationen und Nutzerbedürfnisse berücksichtigen, und entscheidest datenbasiert, ob App, In-App, Push, Mail oder Foodji Screen der richtige Kanal ist.

  • In Snowflake und mit KI-Tools wie Claude analysierst du Daten eigenständig, findest die relevanten Hebel und priorisierst Maßnahmen nach ihrem erwarteten Impact.

  • Mit Marketing, Product, Revenue Management und BI arbeitest du eng zusammen und machst Daten und technische Möglichkeiten für CRM nutzbar. Dem Team, das Kampagnen und Content umsetzt, lieferst du Segmente, Journey-Konzepte und klare Briefings.

  • Du verantwortest Datenqualität und Governance deiner Segmente, Events und Systeme und stellst sicher, dass alles performant, sicher und datenschutzkonform läuft.

  • Du baust unser CRM komplett neu auf und übernimmst die Projektverantwortung für die Integration in unsere System- und Datenlandschaft, von der Anforderungsdefinition bis zum Go-live. Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze oder vergleichbare Plattformen kennst du so gut, dass deine Konzepte direkt umsetzbar sind.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in CRM Analytics, Data Analytics, Lifecycle Marketing oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.

  • Ausgeprägter Datenblick: Du arbeitest sicher mit Daten in Snowflake oder vergleichbaren Data Warehouses, baust komplexe Segmente und Kohorten und leitest daraus klare Maßnahmen ab.

  • Analytics first: Rund 60 bis 70 Prozent deiner Arbeit sind für dich Analytics. Du iterierst schnell über Hypothesen, A/B-Tests und Kohortenanalysen, statt lange an der perfekten Gestaltung zu feilen.

  • Du bist komplett KI-enabled: Tools wie Claude oder MCP nutzt du ganz selbstverständlich in deinem Arbeitsalltag.

  • Gute Kenntnisse in Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze oder einer vergleichbaren CRM-Plattform: Du weißt, was technisch möglich ist, und konzipierst Segmente und Journeys entsprechend. Ein Plus ist Erfahrung mit Omnichannel-Journeys über App, Push, In-App und Mail.

  • Technisches Verständnis und Lust auf enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product: Du kennst die Abläufe zwischen CRM-Systemen, Plattformen und Datenquellen und achtest auf Performance, Sicherheit und Datenschutz.

  • Erfahrung im Aufbau oder in der Einführung eines CRM-Systems: Du übernimmst Ownership, treibst die Integration als Projekt eigenverantwortlich voran und koordinierst die beteiligten Teams und Dienstleister.

  • Sichere Kommunikation auf Deutsch oder Englisch in Wort und Schrift.

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

  • Office Foodji & Lunchit App: Immer bestens versorgt

  • bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente

  • Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung

  • EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios

  • JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec

  • KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind

  • Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands

  • Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen

  • Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Perspektiven!

  • Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU-Ausland

  • Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür

  • Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam!

NOCH FRAGEN?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter!

Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds.

Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst.

Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür.

Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns.

Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt.

This role is located in Munich, Germany. TULIP is a hybrid work environment and we are in the office 3+ days/per week.

About TULIP

TULIP is the frontline operations platform that helps manufacturers digitize, connect and continuously improve how they run production, with AI at the core of the product. TULIP was founded out of the MIT Media Lab. It is headquartered in Boston, has offices in Munich, Tokyo, Tel Aviv, Budapest and Singapore, and has customer sites in more than 45 countries.

In January 2026, TULIP closed its $120M Series D, at a valuation of $1.3B. Leading global manufacturers run on TULIP, including VEKA, DMG Mori, Roche, AstraZeneca, Richemont, Saint-Gobain Aerospace and Mitsubishi Electric. We partner with NVIDIA, PwC, McKinsey, BCG and more than 160 technology partners worldwide. TULIP is part of the World Economic Forum's Global Innovator community, and our CEO, Dr. Natan Linder, co-chairs the Forum's Advanced Manufacturing Industry Governors Community. 

The opportunity in DACH for TULIP

DACH is the heart of global manufacturing. Germany is Europe's largest industrial economy and the birthplace of Industrie 4.0. Switzerland is a global centre for pharma, life sciences and precision manufacturing. Austria is a strong base in automotive, machinery, metals and semiconductors. The region is also home to many of the world's "Hidden Champions", mid-sized companies that lead global niche markets. Today, these companies face similar pressures: fewer skilled workers, rising quality and compliance demands, and the need to modernize existing plants without stopping production. TULIP gives their frontline teams an AI-native production system to meet those pressures and accelerate time-to-value.

TULIP GmbH is a full operating entity and Munich is TULIP's headquarters in Europe. The team covers sales, solutions engineering, pre-sales engineering, customer success, and R&D. Local customers trust our product in regulated, high-precision environments. 

About You

You're an engineering leader who cares about getting security-critical systems right and who wants to reach customers fast, not sit buried in a backlog. You think in specs and failure modes, you stay close to the code, and you're already using AI tooling to change how your team builds, not just how quickly they move. You'll take over a small, strong team and own how the world's most demanding manufacturers authenticate, provision, and govern access for their people and, increasingly, the AI agents acting on their behalf. 

What skills do I need?

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, with direct involvement building and operating security-critical or identity/access systems in production
  • 3+ years of people management experience leading a software team, where you've hired, given constructive feedback, and grown engineers
  • Hands-on depth with OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, OIDC, and SCIM in enterprise environments — you understand the specs and their failure modes, not just the libraries
  • Experience building multi-tenant systems where tenant isolation is a hard requirement
  • Working knowledge of IAM, secrets management, and access policy across AWS and Azure, including the tradeoffs when customers span both
  • A track record of shipping clean, tested code and holding a team to the same standard
  • Active use of AI tooling in your own practice, with a point of view on how it changes the way teams build
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent working experience

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the architecture and roadmap for identity & access — SSO/SAML/OIDC federation, SCIM provisioning, multi-tenant account structures, and the authorization layer across Tulip's multi-cloud infrastructure.
  • Represent Identity & Access in cross-functional architecture reviews and roadmap decisions.
  • Lead and grow a small, high-caliber team — run regular 1:1s, set quality standards, give direct feedback, and develop engineers on security-critical systems.
  • Protect operations where failures carry tangible stakes—from halted production lines to scrapped material and compliance risks. What you ship here has a direct impact on customers. 
  • Drive adoption of AI tooling in how the team builds — code review, test generation, spec drafting, and agent loops — and share what works across engineering.
  • Create and own difficult tradeoffs on IAM and access policy where tenant isolation and enterprise compliance are non-negotiable.
  • Ship work that reaches customers quickly and reliably, with operational excellence as the default.

Key Collaborators

  • Security & Infrastructure  
  • Platform Engineering 
  • Product Management
  • Customer Success

Who we are

Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.

We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi. The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.

We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter, Noah Hollmann, and Sauraj Gambhir, and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.

In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Want to work at the frontier of AI and shape the most forward-looking event formats globally?

Events are where TabPFN meets the world, and one of our strongest channels. We show up at the most talked-about conferences across research and industry, in cities like New York, Seoul, Paris and Sydney, with one ambition: to be the name everyone remembers on the way home. And we create our own moments, from meetups and hackathons to executive dinners people want to be in the room for, where we lead the conversation on AI for tabular data.

You will be at the heart of how our events come together globally. You work hands-on with our Founders office, who owns the events strategy, and alongside sales, research and DevRel. You make sure every detail is taken care of, so every event is flawless on the day and turns into real conversations afterwards.

You'll learn how a fast-growing AI company runs its events, and grow with the program as it scales.

Everything we do is AI-first. We use the latest tools and aim to run events smarter than anyone else, so you'll spend less time on spreadsheets and email chains and more time on the details that make an event worth attending. If you've ever wanted to take event management to the next level, this is the place.

CORE AREAS OF IMPACT

The events we run

  • Industry & academic conferences: from large-scale trade shows to NeurIPS and ICML, wherever they take place around the world

  • Side events & community meetups: the side event everyone talks about, and the meetups and hackathons where people build with TabPFN

  • Executive dinners & briefings: small rooms, senior guests, real conversations, from Berlin to San Francisco

What you'll do across all of them

Help deliver events that bring our brand and product to life:

  • Help shape our events strategy, sponsorships and creative concepts

  • Help shape agendas, find speakers and spot opportunities to maximise our presence, with smart ways to get people curious and excited about TabPFN

  • Run the logistics: venues, vendors, travel, booths and merch

  • Set up invites, Luma pages and guest communication

  • Support the team on site and make every guest experience seamless

  • Help build playbooks and automations, and track what each event delivered

  • Bring the vibe: dream up experiences people talk about, from activations and live demos to gamification, installations or the right DJ. If it makes the night, it's on the table

  • Capture content on site that brings every event to life on our social channels

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You're organised, calm under pressure and obsessed with the details guests notice. You bring a strong executor mindset and know how to build experiences for high-profile guests, from executives and researchers to media and senior partners, with the judgment to make every event feel seamless, elevated and deeply considered. You have:

Essential Background

  • 1-3 years of experience running events, ideally B2B, tech or conferences

  • Hands-on experience with event logistics: venues, vendors, travel, guests

  • Experience with executive dinners, conference booths or side events

  • Great intuition and taste for what looks and feels good, you create experiences people remember and make everyone who didn't show up feel they missed out!

  • A bias for action and experimentation: you'd rather test and learn than wait for a perfect playbook

  • A strong collaborator: you coordinate smoothly with sales, research and DevRel

  • An AI-first way of working: you use the latest tools to run events leaner and faster

  • Structured and reliable: when you own something, it's handled

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills

  • Happy to travel 40%+ internationally

What Makes You Special

  • Experience in an early-stage startup or a fast-growing tech company

  • You've worked with sales and know what makes an event useful for pipeline

  • Familiarity with AI, ML or developer communities

  • Experience with academic or research conferences

  • A network of venues, agencies and vendors in Berlin, London or New York is a plus

LOCATION

Berlin, on-site, with frequent travel

Life at Prior Labs

You'll work alongside researchers and builders who hold themselves to a very high bar - in the quality of their work and in how they work with each other. We move fast and still take the time to do things right.

Our teams are based in Berlin, Freiburg, and New York - when you're working on something as hard as TabPFN, being in the same room matters. But great people come from everywhere, and in exceptional cases we're open to remote, which usually means frequent travel to one of our offices. Wherever you're based, the whole company comes together regularly for offsites to build and celebrate together.

Our Commitments

The best products and teams are built by people with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds. We welcome applications from all identities and walks of life - especially if you've ever felt discouraged by "not checking every box" - and provide equal opportunities regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disability, or any other trait that makes you who you are.

Build something monumental for Healthcare!

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.

We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

You care about making complex systems actually work, not just in theory, but in practice - across teams, stakeholders, and real-world constraints. In previous roles, you were likely the person who brought clarity to messy situations: aligning engineers, partners, and product teams to get things shipped.

At Tandem, you'll drive how our platform connects with the external systems used across French and European healthcare - owning and driving some of the most critical technical initiatives we have. You'll be based in our Munich office, working alongside the local team, in close collaboration with our central Integrations team in Stockholm. From that understanding, you'll find ways to integrate them and shape concrete proposals for how integrations should work, together with external partners.

  • Translate complex technical requirements into clear priorities, plans, and deliverables.

Serving as a primary liaison between investigative sites, Alimentiv and sponsors, the Sr. CRA plays a key role in the successful execution of clinical studies from site selection and start-up through monitoring and close-out. jobs.description_html:
Headquarters: New York, New York, United States; New York, NY; Remote, US (Hub cities)

Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com

An award-winning culture working towards an important mission –  Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including: 

  • TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026)
  • Fortune Change the World (2024)
  • CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024)
  • Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)

About the Role: 

As a Senior Executive Assistant, you will support four to five members of Maven’s C-suite and play an important role in helping them use their time effectively. You’ll manage complex calendars, coordinate travel and meetings, anticipate needs, and keep priorities and follow-ups moving. This role calls for strong judgment, discretion, and a calm, proactive approach. You’ll work closely with the executives you support, the broader Executive Assistant team, and partners across Maven to make sure the details are handled and leaders are prepared to focus on the work that matters most.

What you'll do:

  • Manage complex calendars and scheduling. Coordinate internal and external meetings across competing priorities, maintain clean calendars, and proactively resolve conflicts. Build in appropriate preparation, travel, and follow-up time.
  • Help executives make the best use of their time. Learn their priorities and working styles, flag calendar tradeoffs, identify meetings that may need to be delegated or reconsidered, and surface conflicts or risks early.
  • Coordinate meetings from start to finish. Prepare agendas and materials as needed, confirm attendees and logistics, and make sure meeting links, rooms, and technology are ready. Help executives prepare for high-stakes conversations and track resulting follow-ups.
  • Manage travel and expenses. Arrange door-to-door travel and accommodations, share clear itineraries and relevant materials in advance, monitor travel changes, and submit expenses promptly in line with company policy.
  • Communicate on executives’ behalf. Serve as a thoughtful point of contact for colleagues and external stakeholders. Draft and coordinate clear, concise communications that reflect each executive’s tone and priorities.
  • Support board and investor logistics. Coordinate scheduling, materials, and logistics for board meetings, investor interactions, and other external stakeholder engagements, with discretion and care. Place after “Own logistics of events and gatherings.”
  • Track work and close loops. Maintain an organized view of open tasks, deadlines, and commitments; keep executives and stakeholders informed; and make sure handoffs have clear owners and next steps. Be comfortable working cross-functionally with teams that your execs depend on.
  • Support special projects. Take ownership of selected projects that improve executive operations, team coordination, or the EA team’s shared resources. Identify and implement process improvements for your executives and the EA team.
  • Own logistics of events and gatherings. Coordinate executive and team meetings, offsites, dinners, celebrations, and other events, managing logistics and working with internal partners and vendors often on the ground.
  • Project manage cross-functional strategic initiatives. Be a key player in project management of key projects within your executive’s teams and function, enabling your exec to ensure effective ways of working with their teams and achieving key strategic goals.
  • Use AI thoughtfully to improve how the work gets done. Apply approved AI tools to streamline tasks such as meeting preparation, travel briefs, communications, follow-up tracking, and repeatable workflows. Review AI-generated work for accuracy, use good judgment about what information belongs in which tools, and maintain confidentiality.

What you'll bring: 

  • 4-6 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, including experience supporting senior or C-suite executives; experience supporting multiple executives is a plus.
  • Strong organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage several priorities and adapt as plans change.
  • Sound judgment and the confidence to ask clarifying questions, make recommendations, and escalate risks or blockers early.
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, with the ability to shift priorities quickly.
  • A proactive and hands-on approach: you anticipate needs, prepare ahead, and follow through without needing repeated reminders.
  • Clear, polished communication across email, Slack, meetings, and in-person interactions.
  • The discretion and reliability to handle confidential company, personnel, and executive information.
  • Responsiveness and reliability. Reachable for urgent matters, with the ability to support executives consistently.
  • Experience coordinating complex meetings, travel, and events.
  • Comfort using Google Workspace, Slack, project-management tools, and virtual meeting platforms.
  • Curiosity about AI and experience using AI tools in your work, or the initiative to learn and apply them responsibly.
  • A team player with a collaborative working style, strong accountability, and extreme ownership, who shares knowledge, supports coverage, and helps the EA team work well together.
  • Flexibility to adjust your schedule occasionally, including for travel or time-zone differences, to meet business needs or time-sensitive changes.

The base salary range for this role is $128,000 - $150,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, and skillset.

This role requires active work authorization in the US.

Maven embraces a flexible hybrid work model. Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, and remotely via San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, Seattle, WA. For those in our New York City office, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to work onsite three days a week  (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday). For those based in Boston, DC, Chicago, Seattle, and San Francisco, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to attend monthly Work Together Days within these cities. This policy aims to balance remote work flexibility with the benefits of face-to-face interaction.

At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. If you do not have experience in all of the areas detailed above, we hope that you will share your unique background with us in your application and how it can be additive to our teams.

Benefits That Work For You

Our benefits are designed to support your health, well-being and career development, helping you thrive both personally and professionally. We remain focused on providing a competitive benefits package for our employees. On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits:

  • Maven for Mavens: access to the full platform and specialists, including care for mental health, reproductive health, family planning and pediatrics.
  • Whole-self care through wellness partnerships
  • Hybrid work, in office meals, and work together days 
  • 16 weeks 100% paid parental leave and new parent stipend (for Mavens who've been with us for 1 year+)
  • Annual professional development stipend and access to a personal career coach through Maven for Mavens
  • 401K matching for US-based employees, with immediate vesting

These benefits are applicable to Maven Clinic Co., US-based, full-time employees only. 1099/Contract Providers are ineligible for these benefits. 

Maven is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. Maven is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Maven Clinic interview requests and job offers only originate from an @mavenclinic.com email address (e.g jsmith@mavenclinic.com). Maven Clinic will never ask for sensitive information to be delivered over email or phone. If you receive a scam issue or a security issue involving Maven Clinic please notify us at: security@mavenclinic.com. For general and additional inquiries, please contact us at careers@mavenclinic.com.
